description.value: A small community-managed park on a rocky Strait of Georgia shoreline tucked into a quiet Comox neighbourhood, offering mainland views and shade under mature Douglas firs; no designated swim area and no sani-station on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Kin Beach Park is an active Class C provincial campground with 18 sites (matching OSM capacity tag) in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. Reservations are confirmed via the caretaker phone number listed on both OSM and the website (250-339-6365). The website explicitly mentions a small store selling snacks and toiletries near the parking lot, supporting 'Food nearby'. No mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, potable water, or other amenities, so those are null. OSM internet_access=no aligns with the rural/basic nature of the park.
concerns: No street address available in OSM or on the website
E-bikes are not allowed on trails within the park (text was truncated but restriction is noted); cyclists must keep to roadways
No internet access (confirmed by OSM tag and consistent with basic park infrastructure)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active provincial campground with 18 sites in the Comox Valley, a common touring corridor on Vancouver Island. Basic but functional for cycle tourists with on-site snack store and phone reservations.

wow_evidence: small community-managed park on a rocky Strait of Georgia shoreline... small store selling snacks and toiletries
